# Julian Wortelboer

> Julian Wortelboer is a padel club consultant, operator and Master Coach who helps investors and operators develop distinctive, profitable padel clubs and stronger coaching programs.

## Primary website

- [Julian Wortelboer](https://www.julianwortelboer.com/): Official profile, consulting services, selected club work, coach education and contact information.

## Expertise

- Padel club strategy and development
- Club operations and programming
- Member experience and community development
- Leadership and coach development
- Padel Master Coach education and certification
- Racquet sports direction
